Jonas / Maria,

Thanks for the notes. A few items from FinServ procurement at a high level:

1) Billing model: FinServ requires vendor invoicing (private invoice) for any multi-year commitments; Marketplace transactable purchase is only acceptable for pilot or short-term POCs. We can accept a hybrid approach: initial purchase via Marketplace for trial, then private invoice for committed capacity.

2) Liability / indemnity: Our standard is $10M aggregate; we can entertain $5M for SaaS partners that carry cyber insurance and meet our audit requirements. We need explicit warranty language around data segregation and an SLA credit mechanism.

3) Data residency & logging: All production inference for FinServ must run in the us-east-2 region and retain audit logs for 7 years. SOC2 Type II and penetration test summary required.

4) Payment & PO terms: Net45 preferred; PO and tax forms required prior to invoice.

Please provide an updated term sheet reflecting the hybrid billing approach (Marketplace pilot + private invoice for committed capacity), a proposed SLA with credits, and confirmation of region/residency.

Procurement Team
FinServ Bank

Procurement Team / Maria —

Attaching an edited term sheet and SOW draft with our proposals. Key points we adjusted based on your notes:

- Billing: We included a two-stage approach: (1) Pilot via Marketplace transactable private offer (30–90 days) billed through Marketplace; (2) Post-pilot committed capacity on a private invoicing schedule (Net45) with a transition certificate. We added language for PO issuance and tax forms prior to invoicing.

- Liability: We are willing to accept a $5M aggregate cap provided FinServ confirms cyber insurance of at least $5M and limits punitive damages. We preserved carve-outs for third-party IP claims.

- SLA & credits: Proposed SLA is 99.9% region-specific query availability per month with prorated credits (1% of monthly fees per 30 minutes downtime beyond SLO, capped at 20%). We added a clause for operationally agreed maintenance windows.

- Data residency & logs: Affirmed us-east-2 production enforcement and retention of audit logs for 7 years; we included standard language on export controls and encryption at rest/in transit.

- Microsoft co-sell metadata: We request Microsoft enable the co-sell lead routing to the Redwood AE once the private offer is published — Maria, can you confirm the internal campaign tag and lead routing config required by MSFT?

Attachments: Redwood_Azure_PrivatePlan_TermSheet_v2.pdf; SOW_Draft_Redwood_FinServ.docx

If those attachments look acceptable from your side, please call out any specific redlines (by section) and we can prepare a final packet for DocuSign.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
